title: a lot much many
summary: Слова much, many и a lot of — «много»: с чем их использовать и в каких предложениях.
ru:
## much, many, a lot of
Все три слова значат «много». Выбор зависит от существительного.
| слово | с чем | пример |
|---|---|---|
| **much** | неисчисляемые | much money, much time, much water |
| **many** | исчисляемые во мн. числе | many books, many people |
| **a lot of** | любые | a lot of money / a lot of books |
> Did you buy **much food**? — Ты много еды купила?
> We don't know **many people** here. — Мы здесь не знаем многих людей.
> We bought **a lot of food**. — Мы купили много еды.

## В каких предложениях
- **much** — в **вопросах и отрицаниях**; в утверждении обычно **a lot of**:
> Do you drink **much** coffee? — I don't drink **much** coffee.
> I drink **a lot of** coffee. (не ~~I drink much coffee~~)
- **many** и **a lot of** — в любых предложениях:
> Have you got **many** friends? · We haven't got **many** friends. · We've got **many** friends / **a lot of** friends.

## Глагол после a lot of
Глагол зависит от существительного:
> There **is** a lot of water. (water — ед.)
> There **are** a lot of trees. (trees — мн.)
> A lot of people **speak** English. (people — мн.)

## much и a lot без существительного
> Diane didn't say **much**. — Диана мало что сказала.
> — Do you watch TV much? — No, not **much**. — Нет, не очень часто.
> We go to the cinema **a lot**. — Мы часто ходим в кино.
> I don't like him very **much**. — Он мне не очень нравится.

## How much / How many
> **How much** money do you want? — Сколько денег ты хочешь?
> **How many** photos did you take? — Сколько фото ты сделала?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have much money.~~ → I have **a lot of** money.
- ~~There are much people.~~ → There are **a lot of / many** people.
- ~~How many water do you drink?~~ → How **much** water do you drink?
- ~~A lot of people speaks English.~~ → A lot of people **speak** English.
en:
## much, many, a lot of
| word | with | example |
|---|---|---|
| **much** | uncountable nouns | much money, much time |
| **many** | plural countable nouns | many books, many people |
| **a lot of** | all types of nouns | a lot of money / a lot of books |
> Did you buy **much food**? · We don't know **many people** here. · We bought **a lot of food**.

## In which sentences?
- **much** — questions and negatives; in positive sentences we usually say **a lot of**:
> Do you drink **much** coffee? · I don't drink **much** coffee. · I drink **a lot of** coffee.
- **many** and **a lot of** — all types of sentences.

## The verb after a lot of
> There **is** a lot of water. · There **are** a lot of trees. · A lot of people **speak** English.

## much and a lot without a noun
> Diane didn't say **much**. · — Do you watch TV much? — Not **much**. · We go to the cinema **a lot**.

## How much / How many
> **How much** money do you want? · **How many** photos did you take?

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have much money.~~ → I have **a lot of** money.
- ~~How many water do you drink?~~ → How **much** water do you drink?
- ~~A lot of people speaks English.~~ → A lot of people **speak** English.
structure:
## Таблица
| | исчисляемые (мн.) | неисчисляемые |
|---|---|---|
| вопрос | Have you got **many** books? | Have you got **much** time? |
| отрицание | I haven't got **many** books. | I haven't got **much** time. |
| утверждение | I've got **a lot of** books. | I've got **a lot of** time. |
| сколько? | **How many** books? | **How much** time? |

## Формулы
> **many** + существительное во мн. числе
> **much** + неисчисляемое существительное
> **a lot of** + любое существительное
> **a lot** (без существительного, в конце): *We travel a lot.*

## Короткие ответы
> — Did you take many photos? — Yes, **a lot**. / No, not **many**.
> — Do you eat much bread? — Yes, **a lot**. / No, not **much**.
